This script is for making figures and analyse the climate data for Effektovervåking Trønderlav. Overall aim is to assess to what extend the translocation localities differ climatically from the original locality called Tegningfallet.

## Required packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vroom)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr) 
library(knitr)
library(skimr)
library(gt)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(performance)
library(MuMIn)
library(broom.mixed)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(here)
```

## Loading data

Two cleaned data files are prepared in script 01_Data cleaning and imported here.

```{r}
daily_data <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data", "daily_data.csv"))

daily_data_lux <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data", "daily_data_lux.csv"))
```

## Microclimatic at the localities

Let's make some figures to explore microclimate variables at our localities.

### Microclimate throughout the year

```{r}
#Reorder factor levels:   
locality_order <- c(
  "Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2", "Eldåa", "Nekfallet",
  "Flatdalsåsen", "Gulsvikelvi", "Sagåa", "Trøndelag")

daily_data$locality <- factor(
  daily_data$locality,
  levels = locality_order)

daily_data_lux$locality <- factor(
  daily_data_lux$locality,
  levels = locality_order)
```

Make plots and save figures.

```{r}

#Create a plotting funtion that works for all plots
plot_microclimate <- function(data, variable, y_label) {
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = {{ variable }})) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      x = "Dato",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~locality) +
    theme_minimal()
}

#Make the plots
p.air_temp <- plot_microclimate(
  daily_data,
  mean_temp_C,
  "Temperatur (°C)")

p.rel_hum <- plot_microclimate(
  daily_data,
  mean_rh,
  "Relativ luftfuktighet (%)")

p.dew_point <- plot_microclimate(
  daily_data,
  mean_dp,
  "Duggpunkt (°C)")

p.abs_hum <- plot_microclimate(
  daily_data,
  mean_ah,
  "Absolutt luftfuktighet (g/m³)")

p.lux <- plot_microclimate(
  daily_data_lux, 
  max_lux, 
  "Maksimal lysintensitet (lux)") + scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y")

p.lux.mean <- plot_microclimate(
  daily_data_lux, 
  mean_lux, 
  "Gjennomsnittlig lysintensitet (lux)") + scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y")
  
#Display plots
p.air_temp
p.rel_hum
p.dew_point
p.abs_hum
p.lux
p.lux.mean

#Save plots
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "air_temperature.png"),
  plot = p.air_temp,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "relative_humidity.png"),
  plot = p.rel_hum,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "dew_point.png"),
  plot = p.dew_point,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "absolute_humidity.png"),
  plot = p.abs_hum,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "light_intensity_max.png"),
  plot = p.lux,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "light_intensity_mean.png"),
  plot = p.lux.mean,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")
```

Create some overview tables if needed.

```{r}
summarize_range <- function(data, variable) {
  data %>%
    group_by(locality, year) %>%
    summarize(
      max = max({{ variable }}, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min({{ variable }}, na.rm = TRUE),
      diff = max - min,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

summary_temp <- summarize_range(daily_data, mean_temp_C)
summary_rh   <- summarize_range(daily_data, mean_rh)
summary_dp   <- summarize_range(daily_data, mean_dp)
summary_ah   <- summarize_range(daily_data, mean_ah)
summary_lux  <- summarize_range(daily_data_lux, max_lux)
```

### Time above a certain threshold

Here, we explore the time relative humidity is above a threshold of 90%, which should respond to the lichen being able to hydrate and be photosynthetically active.

```{r}

# set parameters 
threshold_RH   <- 90 # % rh we want to set, should correspond to ecological activity of lichen 
max_gap_hours  <- 6  # ignore intervals > this (e.g., logger outages)

# Calculate percentage of observed time with RH >= threshold
res_overall <- all_data %>%
  filter(type == "temp") %>%
  arrange(locality, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(locality) %>%
  mutate(
    dt_h = as.numeric(
      difftime(lead(timestamp), timestamp, units = "hours")
    ),
    above = rh_percent >= threshold_RH
  ) %>%
  # Remove invalid intervals and long gaps
  filter(
    !is.na(dt_h),
    dt_h > 0,
    dt_h <= max_gap_hours
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    hours_above   = sum(above * dt_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours_observed = sum(dt_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intervals   = n(),
    pct_time_RH90 = 100 * hours_above / hours_observed,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Set locality order
locality_order <- c(
  "Tegningfallet1",
  "Tegningfallet2",
  "Eldåa",
  "Nekfallet",
  "Flatdalsåsen",
  "Gulsvikelvi",
  "Sagåa",
  "Trøndelag"
)

res_overall$locality <- factor(
  res_overall$locality,
  levels = locality_order
)

# Plot
p.rh90 <- ggplot(res_overall, aes(x = locality, y = pct_time_RH90)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_time_RH90)),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "% av logget tid med relativ luftfuktighet ≥ 90%"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

p.rh90

#Save plot

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "time_above_rh_90.png"),
  plot = p.rh90,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")

```

Let's do the same for light intensity.

```{r}

# Explore which localities have high light intensity for the largest proportion of time

# Parameters
threshold_lux  <- 10000  # Light threshold (lux)
max_gap_hours  <- 6      # Ignore intervals longer than this (e.g. logger outages)

# Calculate percentage of observed time with light >= threshold
res_lux <- all_data %>%
  filter(type == "lux") %>%
  arrange(locality, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(locality) %>%
  mutate(
    dt_h = as.numeric(
      difftime(lead(timestamp), timestamp, units = "hours")
    ),
    above = light_lux >= threshold_lux
  ) %>%
  # Remove invalid intervals and long gaps
  filter(
    !is.na(dt_h),
    dt_h > 0,
    dt_h <= max_gap_hours
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    hours_above    = sum(above * dt_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours_observed = sum(dt_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_intervals    = n(),
    pct_time_lux10k = 100 * hours_above / hours_observed,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Set locality order
res_lux$locality <- factor(
  res_lux$locality,
  levels = locality_order
)

# Plot
p.lux10k <- ggplot(res_lux, aes(x = locality, y = pct_time_lux10k)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_time_lux10k)),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "% av logget tid med lysintensitet ≥ 10 000 lux",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Intervals > %g h ignored; threshold = %g lux",
      max_gap_hours,
      threshold_lux
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

p.lux10k

#Save plot
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "time_above_lux_10k.png"),
  plot = p.lux10k,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")
```

## Compare microclimate against Tegningfallet

Now, let's compare the climate at the translocation localities with Tegningfallet.

```{r}
# First, we must create a combined Tegningfallet reference series against which to test the other localities. Here, when available, the average daily values are used, otherwise only data from one of the loggers is used. 

tegningfallet_temp <- daily_data %>%
  filter(locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    temp_tegn = ifelse(
      all(is.na(mean_temp_C)),
      NA_real_,
      mean(mean_temp_C, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop")

# Then, we can join this back to the full dataset and calculate the difference
temp_comparison <- daily_data %>%
  left_join(tegningfallet_temp, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(diff_temp = mean_temp_C - temp_tegn)

#Create a plot
p.temp_comparison <- temp_comparison %>%
  filter(!locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2"),
    !is.na(diff_temp)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = date,
    y = diff_temp,
    color = locality)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~year,
    scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "2 months",
    date_labels = "%b") +
  labs(x = NULL,
    y = "Temperaturforskjell fra Tegningfallet (°C)",
    color = "Lokalitet") +
  theme_minimal()

p.temp_comparison

#This figure is a bit messy, let's try facet wrapping by locality also
ggplot(
  temp_comparison,
  aes(x = date, y = diff_temp)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  facet_grid(locality ~ year, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL,
    y = "Temperaturforskjell fra Tegningfallet (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

That figure is hard to get information out of, let's leave it for now.

In stead, we can make some simpler comparisons,

```{r}

# Combined Tegningfallet reference for relative humidity
tegningfallet_rh <- daily_data %>%
  filter(locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(rh_tegn = ifelse(
      all(is.na(mean_rh)),
      NA_real_,
      mean(mean_rh, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop")

# Compare all localities with combined Tegningfallet
humidity_comparison <- daily_data %>%
  left_join(tegningfallet_rh, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(diff_rh = mean_rh - rh_tegn,
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date))

# Plot mean difference ± SE
p.rh_comparison <- humidity_comparison %>%
  filter(!locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2"),
    !is.na(diff_rh)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = locality, y = diff_rh)) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "bar",
    fill = "steelblue") +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Lokalitet",
    y = "Forskjell i relativ luftfuktighet \nfra Tegningfallet (%)") +
  theme_minimal()

p.rh_comparison

#Save plot
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("img", "comparison_rh.png"),
  plot = p.rh_comparison,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm")

# Compare all localities with combined Tegningfallet
dewpoint_comparison <- daily_data %>%

# Plot mean difference ± SE
p.dp_comparison <- dewpoint_comparison %>%
  filter(!locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2"),
    !is.na(diff_dp)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = locality, y = diff_dp)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
    geom = "bar",
    fill = "steelblue") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",

    linetype = "dashed") +

    y = "Forskjell i duggpunkt fra Tegningfallet (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()

p.dp_comparison

#Save plot
ggsave(filename = here::here("img", "comparison_dp.png"),
  plot = p.dp_comparison,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,

# Let's try for light intensity
# Combined Tegningfallet reference for light intensity
tegningfallet_lux <- daily_data_lux %>%
  filter(locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    lux_tegn = ifelse(
      all(is.na(mean_lux)),
      NA_real_,
      mean(mean_lux, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop")

# Compare all localities with combined Tegningfallet
lux_comparison <- daily_data_lux %>%
  left_join(tegningfallet_lux, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(diff_lux = mean_lux - lux_tegn,
    rel_diff_lux = (mean_lux - lux_tegn) / lux_tegn,
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date))

# Keep locality order consistent
lux_comparison$locality <- factor(
  lux_comparison$locality,
  levels = locality_order)

# Plot mean difference ± SE
p.lux_comparison <- lux_comparison %>%
  filter(!locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2"),
    !is.na(diff_lux)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = locality, y = diff_lux)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
    geom = "bar",
    fill = "steelblue") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Lokalitet",
    y = "Forskjell i gjennomsnittlig lysintensitet \nfra Tegningfallet (lux)") +
```

### Test differences for significance

These are some very simple tests, that do not really take into account any temporal autocorrelation!

```{r}
#Relative humidity

# Exclude the two reference loggers
rh_model_data <- humidity_comparison %>%
  filter(!locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2"),
    !is.na(diff_rh))

# Linear model
model_rh <- lm(diff_rh ~ 0 + locality, data = rh_model_data)

summary(model_rh)

# Estimated differences from Tegningfallet
emmeans(model_rh, ~ locality)

# Test whether differences are significantly different from zero
test(emmeans(model_rh, ~ locality),
  null = 0,
  adjust = "holm")

#Dew point
dp_model_data <- dewpoint_comparison %>%
  filter(!locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2"),
    !is.na(diff_dp))

# Linear model
model_dp <- lm(diff_dp ~ 0 + locality, data = dp_model_data)

summary(model_dp)

# Estimated differences from Tegningfallet
emmeans(model_dp, ~ locality)

# Test whether differences are significantly different from zero
test(emmeans(model_dp, ~ locality),
  null = 0,
  adjust = "holm")


#Light intensity
lux_model_data <- lux_comparison %>%
  filter(!locality %in% c("Tegningfallet1", "Tegningfallet2"),
    !is.na(diff_lux))

# Linear model
model_lux <- lm(diff_lux ~ 0 + locality, data = lux_model_data)

summary(model_lux)

emmeans(model_lux, ~ locality)
test(emmeans(model_lux, ~ locality), null = 0, adjust = "holm")
```
